elements.name: Spiked Armor
elements.desc: Medium armor. Base AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2). Stealth disadvantage. Spiked armor is a rare type of medium armor made by dwarves. It consists of a leather coat and leggings covered with spikes that are usually made of metal.

elements.name: Birdpipes
elements.desc: Pan pipes or satyr pipes, also known as the shalm, these are sacred to Lliira and popular with wood elf and wild elf bards. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Glaur
elements.desc: Short, curved horns like a cornucopia. Played with valves, glaur sound like trumpets, while those without valves, known as gloon, have a more mournful sound. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Hand Drum
elements.desc: A double-headed skin drum fitted with handles along its side. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Longhorn
elements.desc: A Faerûnian flute of sophisticated make, found only in areas with skilled artisans, as in great cities or elven enclaves. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Shawm (SCAG)
elements.desc: A double-reed instrument similar to an oboe or a bassoon, popular with gnomes, who have developed some bellows-powered versions. Musical instrument. Note: this is the SCAG-priced shawm; see the SRD Shawm for the base item.

elements.name: Songhorn
elements.desc: A recorder, a simple type of flute, usually carved from wood. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Tantan
elements.desc: A tambourine, a popular instrument with halflings and humans south of the Dalelands. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Thelarr
elements.desc: Also known as a whistlecane, a simple and easy-to-make wind instrument cut from a reed. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Tocken
elements.desc: A hanging set of carved oval bells, usually played with a pair of light wooden hammers (or open handed). Most common in underground cultures. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Wargong
elements.desc: A metal gong, traditionally made from a shield, particularly the shield of an enemy. Both goblins and dwarves make and play wargongs. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Yarting
elements.desc: A southern instrument from Arnn and Calimshan that is a Faerûnian analog to the guitar. Musical instrument.

elements.name: Zulkoon
elements.desc: A complex pump organ that originated with the zulkirs of Thay, who use it in the casting of their spells. Musical instrument.
